trigger.library_file_added: When a file is added to the library

pickRoom: Choose a channel first: the work runs there and the results go there
intro: At a set time, or when something happens in the project, the AI teammate in a channel starts on its own, puts the results in the channel and notifies you. Say “sum up progress every Monday morning” in a channel and Cheese drafts a routine for you to confirm here
emptyHint: Click “New”, or ask Cheese in a channel to draft one

form.roomHint: The channel's AI teammate does the work, and the results go in this channel
form.name: Name
form.instructionsPlaceholder: e.g. Sum up this week's finished tasks, work in progress and blockers across channels in a one-page weekly report
form.contextPlaceholder: e.g. Tasks and decisions from every channel in this project; only files in the library
form.outputDir: Folder in the channel for results
form.machineNote: The AI teammate's work computer must be online to start. Projects on the cloud can start any time; for projects on your own device, a run waits while the device is offline and is marked failed, with a notification, if it hasn't started within two hours

deleteBody: It stops running and its run history is deleted too; result files already in the channel are kept
roomsFailed: Failed to load this project’s channels
readonly: Owned by {owner} — only they and project admins can change it
